scenes.say: A hundred and two points down, and still champion. How did Márquez do it?
After Mugello he is a hundred and two down. The old comeback record: ninety-one, Bagnaia, twenty twenty-two.
In Hungary Márquez won the sprint and the race, his first grand prix win of the year.
Since Hungary he has scored three hundred sixty-eight points. Bezzecchi's gap melted away.
The sprint. Márquez runs third, title within reach, but on the penultimate lap he crashes at Turn seven.
The title waits. His lead over Martín is fifty-five points, and ninth place on Sunday will do.
Bezzecchi wins, Martín is second, and Márquez comes home eighth. That is enough.
An eighth premier-class title, level with Agostini. Agostini himself handed him a golden helmet.
Next, Valencia, November twenty-seventh to twenty-ninth, the last race of the thousand cc era. Follow it on LapRadar.

title: Márquez is an eight-time champion: how he erased a 102-point gap
